findings.finding: The FY26 guide was already cut on 8 Oct to EBITDA EUR 270-290m, built on 'the most recent business performance', with the low end covering only already-contracted NPE business. Q3 (ended 30 Sep) was effectively in hand when the range was set, which lowers the odds of a second guidance shock on this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 (5 Aug, guide confirmed but made conditional): the stock fell ~16-17% on 6 Aug. The CMD guide cut (8 Oct) was followed by a slide from 1.83 to 1.44 by 19 Oct (-21%). The guidance line has driven this name's largest moves.
findings.original_quote: I range della guidance si basano sull'andamento più recente dell'attività e assunzioni puntuali per la restante parte dell'anno. La parte bassa del range include esclusivamente il nuovo business NPE già contrattualizzato, mentre la parte alta riflette una migliore performance delle collection in Italia nel quarto trimestre. (The guidance ranges rest on the most recent business trend and point assumptions for the rest of the year; the low end includes only NPE new business already contracted, the high end reflects better Italian collections in Q4.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock fell 21% after the cut and has since recovered 24%. What is not priced is the reduced probability of another cut, which a market still fearing one would show as a continued discount. The rebound suggests part of that is already being priced back. Sized small and inside the guide.
findings.independence: Milano Finanza 9 Oct print reports the same cut and the same coeo outperformance: https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/dovalue-cambia-stime-e-strategia-2720142

findings.finding: The issuer buyback (EUR 10m max, started 19 Oct) had spent EUR 2.82m by 30 Oct, buying up to 300k shares a day at the 25%-of-ADV cap. That leaves about EUR 7.2m of mechanical demand, about 3.6 days of the name's ~EUR 1.9m daily turnover, running through the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: From the 19 Oct start to 6 Nov the stock rose from 1.443 to 1.793 (+24%), but the move is not attributable to the buyback alone.
findings.original_quote: Dall'inizio del Programma, doValue ha acquistato n. 1.725.165 azioni proprie (pari allo 0,9073% del capitale sociale), per un controvalore complessivo di Euro 2.816.138. (Since the start of the programme doValue has bought 1,725,165 own shares, 0.9073% of capital, for EUR 2,816,138.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and weekly-disclosed, so the level is priced. What helps is that the buyer is price-insensitive within +/-15% of the prior official price, which can cushion a negative gap on 10 Nov. It is not known whether the broker keeps buying through the results day.
findings.independence: The programme terms (25% ADV cap, +/-15% price band) are in the 19 Oct launch notice: https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-10/20261019_190810.pdf

findings.finding: No sale of the coeo owned backbook (EUR 120-140m market value) had been announced through 6 Nov, per the eMarket doValue filing list. The FY26 leverage target of 2.4-2.6x depends on completing that sale by year-end, and the deadline already slipped once (from the original plan to year-end). The Q3 release must update on it, against a Q3 balance sheet that typically carries seasonal tax payments.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On H1 (5 Aug) leverage of 3.1x and margin compression were cited as the reasons for the ~16-17% fall despite revenue/EBITDA growth (Teleborsa 6 Aug).
findings.original_quote: Il raggiungimento del target di leva finanziaria rimane subordinato al completamento della prevista cessione del portafoglio di crediti di coeo e a dinamiche positive del capitale circolante nel servicing NPL nel secondo semestre (H1 release, 5 Aug 2026: reaching the leverage target remains subject to completing the planned coeo portfolio sale and positive NPL working-capital dynamics in H2.)
findings.why_not_priced: The market knows the sale is pending but has no status update since 8 Oct. A signed deal, or a statement that the process is in exclusivity, would deleverage the equity story, and a further slip would re-open the H1 leverage concern. What the money buys is deleveraging, not distress: Q2 alone collected EUR 31m on the portfolio, and the company says holding it generates cash. So the sign is genuinely two-sided, with a slight negative skew from the absence of any announcement this late.
findings.independence: The 8 Oct CMD release repeats completion 'entro fine 2026' with no status: https://euroborsa.it/public/euroborsa/Comunicati_Stampa/DoValue/doValue_8_ottobre_2026.pdf

findings.finding: Intrum's Q3 report (23 Oct) showed servicing income still under pressure and a continued negative trend in Germany, with a SEK 1.5bn German goodwill impairment. Germany is coeo's core market and coeo now supplies ~31% of doValue revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 25 Aug doValue fell ~6.8% on a Klarna guidance cut, a read-through from coeo's client. Counterparty news has moved it before.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, and it is a proxy: Intrum's German book is traditional servicing, while coeo is digital-native collections, which doValue itself said on 8 Oct (after Q3 ended) was beating expectations. That company-level statement outranks the peer proxy, so this is sized near zero.
